exchange.name: BingX (Futures)
exchange.evidence: Explicit vendor API ID field, F604 proof BINGX_EXACT_API_ID
exchange.family: Mixed derivatives exchange; page exposes perpetual USDT and USDC.

route.purpose: One vendor-attributed identity batch, no prices/metric scoring.

expected_documented_identity_fields.no_guarantee: Required schema does not prove populated values or presence for all550.

bridge_rule.vendor_layer: Exact requested BingX derivative venue + returned pair/type/tradeURL + explicit coinIDs is direct provider attribution, not a symbol-only cross-venue match.
bridge_rule.native_layer: Propose internal bindings only for one unambiguous ROOT-accepted selected native tuple: exact vendor-native symbol or a previously primary-proven alias, PERPETUAL, quote/margin/settleUSDT. TargetUSDT alone does not prove margin family.
bridge_rule.trade_url: Preserve original, validate HTTPS and BingX host; do not fetch it or invent path aliases.
bridge_rule.unknown_rule: Missing/empty IDs, conflicting venue, aliases, duplicate pairs or unproven family remain UNKNOWN; no prefix stripping, syntheticcontractIDs or ASCII filter.

remaining_gaps: IP/shared whole-budget remaining and actual call receipt
